name: Chrome-Environment (V4)
onCreateCommand: docker system prune -a --volumes -f && docker pull ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest
postStartCommand:
git pull origin main && mkdir -p ~/.chrome-data && docker rm -f chrome 2>/dev/null || true && docker run -d --name=chrome --restart=always -p 8080:3000 -v /home/vscode/.chrome-data:/config -e AUTO_LOGIN=true -e SUBFOLDER=/ -e CHROME_CLI="--disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --no-sandbox" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size=2gb ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest && echo 'alias update-version="git pull origin main && devcontainer-cli rebuild --workspace-folder . 2>/dev/null || echo -e "
✅ Local repository updated to latest commit! Please press F1 -> Codespaces: Full Rebuild Container to reload Docker cleanly.
""' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'git fetch origin main >/dev/null 2>&1 && LOCAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && REMOTE=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && if [ $LOCAL != $REMOTE ]; then NEW_VER=$(git show origin/main:.devcontainer/devcontainer.json | grep -oP "(?<="name": ")[^"]*"); echo -e "
=========================================
🚀 UPDATE AVAILABLE: $NEW_VER
Type: update-version (or press F1 -> Rebuild)
=========================================
"; fi' >> ~/.bashrc
